surfaces.name: Filter resources
surfaces.reason: Opened only from the main screen's filter button; the main page explains the filter entry.

surfaces.name: Beam animation
surfaces.reason: A preview opened from one settings row; the settings page explains that row.

surfaces.name: Cross-device packets
surfaces.reason: A list opened from one settings row; the settings page explains that row.

surfaces.name: Data transfer
surfaces.reason: Opened only from the General settings tab; its page explains the export and import entry.

surfaces.name: Default apps
surfaces.reason: Opened only from the General settings tab; its page explains the default apps entry.

surfaces.name: Edge gestures
surfaces.reason: Opened only from a settings row; the settings page explains the gesture entry.

surfaces.name: Launcher settings
surfaces.reason: Opened only from the General settings tab; its page explains the launcher entry.

surfaces.name: Launcher wallpaper
surfaces.reason: Opened only from the launcher settings; the General settings page explains the launcher entry.

surfaces.name: Enable everything
surfaces.reason: A one-message explainer opened from the welcome screen; the welcome page covers it.

surfaces.name: Open a file the app cannot show
surfaces.reason: Opened from a file row of the file browser that the app cannot play itself; the browser page covers the row.

surfaces.name: Send to
surfaces.reason: The Send to list of the file browser's file and selection menus; the browser page covers sending files.

surfaces.name: Player: open with
surfaces.reason: The player opened by another app for one file; it has the same controls as the player, so the player page covers it.

surfaces.name: Audio player: open with
surfaces.reason: The audio player opened by another app or a shortcut for one file; the player page covers the same controls.

surfaces.name: Photo and video player: open with
surfaces.reason: The photo and video viewer opened by another app or a shortcut for one file; the player page covers the same controls.

surfaces.name: Document viewer: open with
surfaces.reason: The document viewer opened by another app or a shortcut for one file; the player page covers the same controls.

surfaces.name: Text viewer: open with
surfaces.reason: The text viewer opened by another app or a shortcut for one file; the player page covers the same controls.

surfaces.name: Now playing
surfaces.reason: The queue sheet opened from the player's audio controls; the player page covers audio playback.

surfaces.name: Playback control
surfaces.reason: Opened by the Control button of the player; the player page explains that button.

surfaces.name: Slideshow settings
surfaces.reason: Opened from the slideshow button of the player; the player page explains the slideshow.

surfaces.name: Search in the book
surfaces.reason: Opened from the player's book search button; the player page covers reading books.

surfaces.name: Book contents
surfaces.reason: Opened from the player's book controls; the player page covers reading books.

surfaces.name: Page thumbnails
surfaces.reason: Opened from the player's PDF controls; the player page covers reading documents.

surfaces.name: Choose a track
surfaces.reason: A track list opened from the stopwatch settings, not from the player; one pick from a list, so its title is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Open the guide
surfaces.reason: A message with the address and a QR code; its text is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Help
surfaces.reason: It is itself help: the page viewer opened by F1 and the help action.

surfaces.name: Keyboard shortcuts
surfaces.reason: It is itself help: the shortcut list of the screen it was opened from.

surfaces.name: Find shares on the network
surfaces.reason: Opened only from the add-resource form to look for shares on the local network; the add-resource page explains the search.

surfaces.name: Google Drive folder
surfaces.reason: Opened from the add-resource form to pick a folder in the cloud account; the add-resource page covers cloud storage.

surfaces.name: OneDrive folder
surfaces.reason: Opened from the add-resource form to pick a folder in the cloud account; the add-resource page covers cloud storage.

surfaces.name: Dropbox folder
surfaces.reason: Opened from the add-resource form to pick a folder in the cloud account; the add-resource page covers cloud storage.

surfaces.name: Sign in
surfaces.reason: The in-app sign-in page opened from the saved authorizations list; the authorizations page explains signing in.

surfaces.name: Shared cloud channel
surfaces.reason: Opened by the file browser when a shared cloud channel has to be chosen; the browser page covers the folders it shows.

surfaces.name: Choose an icon
surfaces.reason: Opened from the icon row of the resource editor; the editor page explains the icon choice.

surfaces.name: Launch panel
surfaces.reason: The panel itself, drawn inside its transparent host; the quick launch page covers it.

surfaces.name: Choose an app
surfaces.reason: Opened from the tile editor to choose an installed app; the editor page explains the choice.

surfaces.name: Choose a system shortcut
surfaces.reason: Opened from the tile editor to choose a system shortcut; the editor page explains the choice.

surfaces.name: Choose a screen of the app
surfaces.reason: Opened from the tile editor to choose a screen of this app; the editor page explains the choice.

surfaces.name: Choose a resource
surfaces.reason: Opened from the tile editor to choose a resource; the editor page explains the choice.

surfaces.name: Choose a stream
surfaces.reason: A list of streams opened from a settings row; the settings page explains that row.

surfaces.name: Device profile
surfaces.reason: Opened from the General settings tab to change the device profile; the settings page explains the profile.

surfaces.name: Calculator settings
surfaces.reason: Opened by the settings button of the calculator; the calculator page explains the options.

surfaces.name: Stopwatch result
surfaces.reason: Opened by the Result button of the stopwatch; the stopwatch page explains saving and sending the result.

surfaces.name: Stopwatch settings
surfaces.reason: Opened by the settings button of the stopwatch; the stopwatch page explains the options.

surfaces.name: Camera settings
surfaces.reason: Opened by the settings button of the camera; the camera page explains the options.

surfaces.name: Record a key
surfaces.reason: Opened by choosing an action in the remap list to record its key; the remap page explains recording.

surfaces.name: Download the stream
surfaces.reason: Offered by the player while a stream plays; the player page covers playing streams.

surfaces.name: Resources for the watch
surfaces.reason: Opened from the watch sync settings to choose which resources the watch shows; the companion page explains the choice.

surfaces.name: Import resources
surfaces.reason: A transparent host for a resource file opened from another app; only its confirmation and result dialogs are visible, and their text is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Import access file
surfaces.reason: A transparent host for an access file opened from another app; only its confirmation and result dialogs are visible, and their text is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Quick audio recorder
surfaces.reason: A transparent host that asks for the microphone permission and starts a recording from a widget or a shortcut, then closes; it draws nothing of its own (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Quick camera capture
surfaces.reason: A transparent host that asks for the camera permission and hands over to the camera, then closes; it draws nothing of its own (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Resource widget
surfaces.reason: Opened by the launcher when the widget is placed; it asks for one resource, so its title is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Stream widget
surfaces.reason: Opened by the launcher when the widget is placed; it asks for one stream, so its title is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Photo frame widget
surfaces.reason: Opened by the launcher when the widget is placed; it asks for one photo source, so its title is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Quick capture widget
surfaces.reason: Opened by the launcher when the widget is placed; it asks for one capture target, so its title is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Choose a colour
surfaces.reason: A palette with a preview used by the screen flashlight and the destination settings; one pick from a list, so its title is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Choose a language
surfaces.reason: A searchable list of languages used by many screens; one pick from a list, so its title is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Choose an option
surfaces.reason: A searchable list of options used by many screens; one pick from a list, so its title is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Black screen
surfaces.reason: A solid black screen with no controls; any touch closes it (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Game help
surfaces.reason: It is itself help: the rules and the legend of the game.

surfaces.name: Scan a QR code
surfaces.reason: A camera viewfinder that reads one QR code; its on-screen hint is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Share by QR code
surfaces.reason: One QR code with its hint; the text on screen is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Sign in to the exchange server
surfaces.reason: A transparent host that shows the same quick sign-in dialog as the My devices screen; the My devices page explains the connection string and the sign-in fields.

surfaces.name: Live broadcast entry
surfaces.reason: A routing proxy with no window: the shortcut, tile, widget and panel entries open the broadcast control screen through it, and it closes at once (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Broadcast share entry
surfaces.reason: A routing proxy with no window: an old share shortcut or external intent lands on the broadcast control screen through it, and it closes at once (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Cast offer answer
surfaces.reason: A transparent target of the Accept and Decline buttons of a cast notification; it draws nothing of its own and closes after the answer (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Clipboard exchange
surfaces.reason: A translucent window behind sending the clipboard to the server and getting it back; only its progress and result dialogs are visible, and their text is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Receive a shared file
surfaces.reason: A transparent host for the system Share sheet; only the choice of a destination and the result dialogs are visible, and their text is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).

surfaces.name: Download an optional component
surfaces.reason: An offer to download one optional component: the title names it, the message gives the size, and a progress bar follows; opened from many screens, and its text is the whole explanation (CONTEXT-HELP rule 4).
